name: Horizon Europe · HORIZON-NATURE-2027-02-05: Cost-effective biodiversity monitoring
status: Scheduled to open 13 Oct 2026 · portal status unverified · consortium required
amount: €16 million topic budget; expected €5–6 million per project for three projects. Lump-sum RIA; this is not funding available directly to Talk2Nature.
fit: This is not a current bid fit, standalone opportunity or lead application. The topic requires a policy-facing demonstration in one of three specific areas: the EU Pollinators Monitoring Scheme under the Nature Restoration Regulation, soil biodiversity under the Soil Monitoring Law, or Water Framework Directive monitoring. It calls for scalable and cost-effective monitoring, demonstrations, species identification/quantification, relevant genomic methods and FAIR-by-design data. Talk2Nature is currently an experimental passive audio observation/annotation tool, with no validated statutory monitoring, identification/counting, DNA or Water Framework Directive method. At most, it could be a limited software or interoperability contribution inside an eligible consortium if a demonstrated need emerges. The applicant entity, scientific lead and consortium are unconfirmed.
next_action: The official REA schedule and work programme list opening on October 13, 2026 and a January 14, 2027 deadline at 17:00 Brussels time. The Funding & Tenders topic page could not be retrieved during the October 13 review, so actual submission status is unverified; do not call it open until the official portal confirms that. Reassess only if the portal is available and a qualified, eligible consortium identifies a concrete need that matches a tested Talk2Nature workflow. The information day is October 16 and brokerage event October 19; no registration, outreach or application has been made.
application_status: Not pursued; portal status unverified; current fit, applicant and consortium not established
